text:
A force acts on an area to produce a pressure.
Which changes produce the same pressure?
A
double the area and double the force
B
double the area and halve the force
C
double the area and make the force four times bigger
D
halve the area and double the force

options.label: A
options.text: double the area and double the force

options.label: B
options.text: double the area and halve the force

options.label: C
options.text: double the area and make the force four times bigger

options.label: D
options.text: halve the area and double the force
